description: This file manages contact names for BlueBubbles participants, including caching, database querying, and platform-specific contact resolution, primarily for macOS contacts.

methods.name: enrichBlueBubblesParticipantsWithContactNames
methods.description: Enriches participant objects with contact names by resolving phone numbers via macOS contacts or provided resolver.

methods.name: listBlueBubblesContactsDatabasesForTest
methods.description: Lists contact database files on macOS for testing purposes.

methods.name: queryBlueBubblesContactsDatabaseForTest
methods.description: Queries a specific contact database for contact names based on phone keys, for testing.

methods.name: resolveBlueBubblesParticipantContactNamesFromMacOsContactsForTest
methods.description: Resolves contact names from macOS contacts for given phone keys, for testing.

methods.name: resetBlueBubblesParticipantContactNameCacheForTest
methods.description: Clears the contact name cache, for testing.

methods.name: setBlueBubblesParticipantContactDepsForTest
methods.description: Sets dependencies for contact name resolution, for testing.
